name: Manus
description: Manus is an autonomous AI agent platform that can browse the web, execute code, manage files, and complete complex multi-step tasks independently — positioning itself as a general-purpose AI agent that goes beyond chat to take real actions.

writing-chat.summary: Manus provides a conversational interface for task delegation, where users describe complex objectives and the agent plans and executes them autonomously, providing updates and results through the chat.

subFeatures.name: Task-Oriented Chat
subFeatures.description: Describe complex tasks in natural language — Manus breaks them into steps, creates an execution plan, and works through them autonomously

subFeatures.name: Progress Updates
subFeatures.description: Real-time visibility into agent execution with step-by-step progress, browser screenshots, and action logs

subFeatures.name: Result Delivery
subFeatures.description: Agent presents completed task results in chat with links to generated files, data, and deliverables

limitations: Chat is task-execution focused, not general conversation
Response times are longer due to autonomous execution (minutes, not seconds)
Not suitable for quick Q&A or casual conversation
Agent may require clarification for ambiguous tasks

pricingTiers.details: Limited task credits per month
More task credits with priority execution
Shared workspace with team task management

versionHistory.changes: Public launch of autonomous AI agent with chat-based task delegation

research.summary: Manus excels at autonomous web research — it browses multiple websites, compiles information, cross-references sources, and produces comprehensive research reports without human intervention.

subFeatures.name: Autonomous Web Research
subFeatures.description: Agent independently browses the web, visits multiple sources, and compiles research findings into structured reports

subFeatures.name: Multi-Source Synthesis
subFeatures.description: Cross-reference information from dozens of websites to produce comprehensive, fact-checked research outputs

subFeatures.name: Research Report Generation
subFeatures.description: Produce formatted research reports with citations, comparisons, and analysis as downloadable documents

limitations: Cannot access paywalled or login-protected content
Research quality depends on available public web sources
May be slow for time-sensitive research (minutes per task)
Cannot guarantee accuracy of all extracted information

pricingTiers.details: Limited research tasks per month
More research tasks with higher priority

file-analysis.summary: Manus can read and analyze files within its execution environment, including documents, data files, and code, as part of completing assigned tasks.

subFeatures.name: Document Analysis
subFeatures.description: Read and analyze uploaded documents, extracting key information and answering questions about content

subFeatures.name: Data File Processing
subFeatures.description: Process CSV, JSON, and spreadsheet files within the agent's execution environment for data analysis tasks

limitations: File analysis is part of task execution, not a standalone feature
Upload size limits apply
Cannot analyze all file formats — focused on common document and data types
Analysis depth depends on task context and instructions

pricingTiers.details: File analysis as part of task credits
Higher file size limits and more complex analysis tasks

versionHistory.changes: File upload and analysis within agent tasks

document-creation.summary: Manus creates documents as task deliverables — research reports, data compilations, spreadsheets, and formatted documents generated autonomously during task execution.

subFeatures.name: Report Generation
subFeatures.description: Autonomously generate comprehensive reports from research, data analysis, and web extraction tasks

subFeatures.name: Spreadsheet Creation
subFeatures.description: Create and populate spreadsheets with structured data extracted from web sources or computed from uploaded data

subFeatures.name: Multi-Format Output
subFeatures.description: Generate deliverables in multiple formats including markdown, CSV, HTML, and document files

limitations: Document creation is a byproduct of task execution, not a writing tool
No collaborative document editing
Output quality varies with task complexity
No fine-grained document formatting controls

pricingTiers.details: Document creation as part of task credits
Larger and more complex document generation

versionHistory.changes: Multi-format document creation as task deliverables

image-generation.summary: Manus does not generate images directly. While the agent can interact with web-based image generation tools, it does not have a native image generation capability.

subFeatures.name: Not Available Natively
subFeatures.description: Manus focuses on web browsing, code execution, and data tasks — image generation is not a built-in capability, though the agent could potentially use web-based image tools

limitations: No native image generation model
Cannot create visual assets directly
Would need to use external web-based tools for image tasks

pricingTiers.details: Not available as native capability

prototyping.summary: Manus can write and execute code as part of its task execution, enabling basic prototyping capabilities including script writing, data processing code, and simple application creation.

subFeatures.name: Code Execution
subFeatures.description: Write and execute Python code within the agent's sandbox environment for data processing, automation scripts, and computation tasks

subFeatures.name: Web Application Prototyping
subFeatures.description: Create simple web pages, tools, and applications as task deliverables that can be previewed and downloaded

limitations: Code execution limited to sandbox environment capabilities
Not a full-featured coding assistant — better suited for data processing and scripting
Cannot create complex multi-file applications
No IDE integration or persistent development environment

pricingTiers.details: Code execution as part of task credits
More complex code execution tasks with higher time limits

versionHistory.changes: Code execution capability within agent sandbox

personalization.summary: Manus has minimal personalization features. Tasks are standalone and there is no persistent preference or instruction system across tasks.

subFeatures.name: Task Instructions
subFeatures.description: Provide detailed instructions for each task to guide agent behavior, but these do not persist across tasks

limitations: No persistent user preferences or instructions
No custom instruction system like ChatGPT
No memory of past task preferences
Each task starts from a clean state

pricingTiers.details: No dedicated personalization features

persistent-context.summary: Manus maintains a history of completed tasks and their deliverables, allowing users to review and reference past task results.

subFeatures.name: Task History
subFeatures.description: Complete history of all executed tasks with instructions, execution logs, and deliverables accessible in the dashboard

subFeatures.name: Deliverable Storage
subFeatures.description: Generated files and reports stored and downloadable from the task history for future reference

limitations: No cross-task memory or learning
Agent does not remember previous task context in new tasks
Storage limits on retained deliverables
No knowledge base or persistent document storage

pricingTiers.details: Limited task history retention
Extended task history and deliverable storage

versionHistory.changes: Task history and deliverable storage dashboard

agents.summary: Manus is built from the ground up as an autonomous AI agent. It plans, reasons, and executes complex multi-step tasks across web browsing, code execution, and file management without human intervention.

subFeatures.name: Autonomous Task Planning
subFeatures.description: Agent analyzes the task objective, creates a multi-step execution plan, and works through each step independently

subFeatures.name: Browser Automation
subFeatures.description: Control a full web browser to navigate sites, fill forms, click buttons, scroll, and interact with web applications

subFeatures.name: Code Execution Agent
subFeatures.description: Write and run code in a sandboxed environment to process data, make calculations, and generate outputs

subFeatures.name: File Management
subFeatures.description: Create, read, edit, and organize files within the agent's workspace as part of task execution

subFeatures.name: Multi-Tool Orchestration
subFeatures.description: Seamlessly combine web browsing, code execution, and file management within a single complex task

limitations: No desktop application control — limited to web browser and sandbox
Complex tasks may take significant time (10+ minutes)
Agent may make mistakes that require task restart
Cannot interact with mobile apps or native desktop software
CAPTCHA and anti-bot measures can block web tasks

pricingTiers.details: Limited task credits for agent execution
More task credits, longer execution times, priority processing
Shared agent workspace with team collaboration

versionHistory.changes: General-purpose autonomous AI agent with multi-tool orchestration
Limited preview release with invite-only access

connectors.summary: Manus connects to the web through its built-in browser automation and can interact with any publicly accessible web service. It also provides API access for programmatic task submission.

subFeatures.name: Web Service Interaction
subFeatures.description: The agent can interact with any publicly accessible web service through browser automation — effectively connecting to any web-based tool

subFeatures.name: API Access
subFeatures.description: Programmatic task submission and result retrieval through the Manus API for integration into workflows

limitations: No native integrations with specific third-party tools
Web service interaction limited to what a browser can access
No OAuth or SSO connectors for authenticated services
API integration requires development effort

pricingTiers.details: Web interaction through browser agent
API access for programmatic task submission
Advanced API features and team integration

versionHistory.changes: Programmatic API for task submission and result retrieval

dictation.summary: Manus does not include voice input or dictation capabilities. All task instructions are provided through text.

subFeatures.name: Not Available
subFeatures.description: Manus accepts task instructions through text input only — no voice or speech-to-text capabilities

limitations: No voice input or dictation support
No speech-to-text capabilities
Text-only task instruction interface

pricingTiers.details: Not available
